desc: Part of the Quartz team.
Part of the Prime Video iOS Client team responsible for all pages within the iOS/tvOS application.
Worked on the Full Prime Video stack, including the Python/Java/Kotlin/JavaScript backend and Swift/Objective-C frontend.
Created automated UI tests, integration tests and end-to-end tests to increase overall test coverage to 90%.
Led key investigations and architected solutions to solve issues with increases in memory consumption. Solutions increased App Availability to 99.9%, a record high.
Carried out regular support work on-call, solving tickets from neighbouring teams and customer tickets.
Led the migration of the team’s alarms and dashboards to AWS CloudWatch using TypeScript.

Created proposals for new features, considering the different APIs involved, team resources and overall design/approach, using the whole software development lifecycle. The features were then developed and put into production.

Creation of the Tier 1 PV iOS Edge Service using Python, Java & Kotlin using an ECS on AWS Fargate solution, capable of withstanding high TPS with low latency, ensuring a smooth, consistent client experience. This resulted in an increased throughput of 10 times and a reduced CPU cost by 70%.
Automated the load testing workflow in order to test new client-consumed APIs fast and efficiently, increasing developer velocity and reducing the number of developer days required by 65%.
Regular use of Test & Behaviour Driven Development (TDD/BDD) practices to ensure code is robust and adheres to user and stakeholder requirements.
Led a team of four engineers to migrate the largest API responsible for serving the PV Details Page, reducing average P90 latency by 26.2%, with no major issues during dial up.

Led the migration of all PV iOS traffic from the DUB to ZAZ data centre, liaising with key dependency stake holders, conducting shadow, QA and load testing. Managed a junior SDE in order to complete code changes.
Co-lead a project which involved the whole software development lifecycle, from the design with a project specification to the implementation, testing and documentation.
Bash & Powershell scripting.
Use of the Golang programming language for a command-line based messenging client.
Use of Azure Devops CI/CD and various testing frameworks e.g. Robot Integration testing
Use of virtual environments using Hyper-V and VMware in additon to Docker containers.
Creation of a WebSocket Server for use with the Frontend system.
Validation of group payments and integration of backend system with Frontend user interface.
Use of Amazon DynamoDB for storing group payments, groups, and users.
Creation of login & authentication for users of the merchant dashboard.
